summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for admin customer intelligence templates/metrics/history/timeline and credentialed CORS checks. Core feature flows pass on preview except external OPTIONS preflight credentials, which is still edge-intercepted.

critical.issue: External preview preflight still responds with access-control-allow-origin: * and no access-control-allow-credentials=true. Local FastAPI OPTIONS returns explicit origin + credentials=true.

action_items: Fix edge/ingress preflight handling so external OPTIONS mirrors app credentialed CORS contract (explicit allow-origin + allow-credentials=true).
Keep app-level middleware behavior as-is; regression indicates issue is upstream of FastAPI.
Optional hardening: remove default credentials fallback in backend/core/config.py to enforce env-only fail-fast behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin customer intelligence backend contract is correct: overview includes campaign_templates/campaign_metrics/radar_history and responses do not leak _id/ObjectId in validated payloads.
Admin authz gates are correct for overview, radar/templates/history/action endpoints (unauth/non-admin blocked).
backend/core/config.py still contains default fallback values for sensitive env vars (e.g., ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD), which conflicts with strict env-only fail-fast guidance.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md accounts: admin@bidblitz.com / BidBlitz2026! and haendler@bidblitz.com / Haendler2026!
seed_data_creation: Created one QA radar template via UI and executed at least one radar combo action; backend tests also created QA template/action records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Before running pytest manually, export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env in shell; otherwise this suite will skip. UI selector contract is now stable for admin-grid-customer-intelligence and /admin/customer-intelligence panels.
rca of the issue: Reproduced with curl: preview URL OPTIONS is answered by Cloudflare/edge with wildcard CORS and no allow-credentials, while localhost:8001 FastAPI returns explicit origin and allow-credentials=true. This indicates ingress/edge interception override, not a backend route regression.
